notes: Chunk 59: 1 program-list, 0 single-record, 24 not-a-list. The only list page is the UBC Sauder PhD alumni page for 1972-79 (capture 2018-10-23), a table of about 27 graduates grouped by graduation year with 'Current University' (often blank) and a division code; 'SC' (presumably Management Science / Operations) graduates include Amin Amershi, Jerry Kallberg, Martin Kusy, Stig Larsson, Dennis Kira, Katsushige Sawaki and Celik Parkan. The page gives current affiliations at capture time, not first placements, and some entries show personal email addresses which should not be copied into the dataset. Sibling pages for later cohorts (e.g. /Alumni/1980-89) probably exist under the same path and are worth a targeted look if not already in the candidate set. All other candidates are careers/placement-year guidance, master's dissertation grant or advice pages, non-management research group thesis pages, login walls, or an error page. Institutions kept as given throughout.
